opening.argument: The video directly solicits participation in BitConnect by directing viewers to “Join the team” through an external link and attaching a 3% claim to that invitation. The speaker reinforces that solicitation by presenting the platform as serious and asserting personal investment, encouraging viewers to trust and participate in the promoted investment platform. This combination of an invitation to join, a stated return, and personal endorsement supports the investment-pool promotion at issue.
